title: On Swinging from the beam by the barn
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：swing　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 swing 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the sign ① swung from the beam by the barn in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the sign ② swings from the beam by the barn without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ swing from the beam by the barn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ swung from the beam by the barn before — a line in the plan for October 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Swinging from the beam by the barn in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the sign ever ⑥ swings round to the west in the night without complaint before the October rains, nobody in the site would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ swing round to the west in the night without complaint and never speak of it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a second sign ⑧ swings round to the west in the night in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the site said a word; ⑨ The sign swung from the beam by the barn again in 1980, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To swing from the beam by the barn, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, the sign swings from the beam by the barn without complaint again and the sign must swing from the beam by the barn in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 摆动（一般过去式 swung from the beam by the barn：1970 年那块招牌头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 摆动（一般现在 swings from the beam by the barn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 摆动（不定式 to swing from the beam by the barn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 摆动（过去完成时 had swung from the beam by the barn：1964 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 摆动（动名词 swinging from the beam by the barn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 转向（swings round to the west in the night：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真转向夜里转向西边）
G. v. 转向（swing round to the west in the night：let it 之后的原形，指随它去夜里转向西边）
H. v. 摆动（后段两处：后来的那块招牌照例 swings round to the west in the night，而那块招牌在 1980 年又一次 swung from the beam by the barn）

answers.why: swing 意为“摆动”，1970 年那块招牌淋着雨摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 swung。
swing 意为“摆动”，自那以后那块招牌毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 swings。
swing 意为“摆动”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去”，此处为不定式 to swing from the beam by the barn。
swing 意为“摆动”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人摆动过，故用过去完成时 had swung。
swing 意为“摆动”，那块招牌说“摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 swinging from the beam by the barn 作主语。
swing 意为“转向”，叔叔说的是“万一那块招牌真转向夜里转向西边”，if 从句里用一般现在 swings round to the west in the night。
swing 意为“转向”，老手们的规矩是“随它转向夜里转向西边”（let it swing round to the west in the night），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
swing 意为“摆动”，后来的那块招牌每个月份都照例转向夜里转向西边，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 swings。
swing 意为“摆动”，那块招牌在 1980 年在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去，用一般过去式 swung 叙述。
swing 意为“摆动”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，那块招牌淋着雨摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（swung from the beam by the barn）
多年以后，那块招牌仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（swings from the beam by the barn）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去这件事本身。（to swing from the beam by the barn）
早在 1964 年就有人摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had swung from the beam by the barn）
那块招牌说过，淋着雨摆动在谷仓的梁上荡来荡去这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（swinging from the beam by the barn 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它转向夜里转向西边，以后再也不要提起。（let it swing round to the west in the night）
answers: In 1970 the sign swung from the beam by the barn in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the sign still swings from the beam by the barn without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to swing from the beam by the barn at all was the part nobody had expected.
The sign had swung from the beam by the barn long before 1977, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Swinging from the beam by the barn in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 swing 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the sign swung from the beam by the barn in the rain, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the sign swings from the beam by the barn without complaint whenever the site asks.
Swinging from the beam by the barn in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the sign ever swings round to the west in the night without complaint before the October rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second sign swings round to the west in the night in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
The sign swung from the beam by the barn again in 1980, and this time nothing was written down.
